parameters.query:
select 'part_1_org_snapshot' as query_name,
       'org_snapshot' as variable_name,
       object_construct_keep_null(*) as value,
       object_construct('source_table','marts.customer_base.agg_current_customer') as metadata
from marts.customer_base.agg_current_customer
where organization_id = {{$json.body.organization_id}}
union all
select 'part_1_snapshot_columns', column_name,
       object_construct('data_type', data_type, 'ordinal_position', ordinal_position, 'comment', comment),
       object_construct('source_table','marts.customer_base.agg_current_customer')
from marts.information_schema.columns
where table_schema = 'CUSTOMER_BASE' and table_name = 'AGG_CURRENT_CUSTOMER'
union all
select 'part_1_snapshot_table_inventory', table_name,
       object_construct('table_schema', table_schema),
       object_construct('source_database','MARTS')
from marts.information_schema.tables
where table_schema = 'CUSTOMER_BASE' and table_name ilike '%CURRENT_CUSTOMER%';

parameters.query:
select 'addendum_ltv_feature_adoption' as query_name,
       f.key::string as variable_name,
       f.value as value,
       object_construct('source_table','production.ltv.ltv_feature_adoption_scores') as metadata
from (
  select object_construct_keep_null(
    'organization_id', organization_id,
    'bizdate', bizdate,
    'plan_tier', plan_tier,
    'segment_actual', segment_actual,
    'months_enrolled', months_enrolled,
    'total_mrr', total_mrr,
    'features', features
  ) as row_data
  from production.ltv.ltv_feature_adoption_scores
  where organization_id = {{$json.body.organization_id}}
  qualify row_number() over (order by bizdate desc) = 1
) r,
lateral flatten(input => r.row_data) f;
